text: Management Plus facilitates bookkeeping by automatically expanding and processing downloadable credit card transaction statements.
Alexandre Ouaknine is the creator of the Fully Automated Credit Card Statement Analyzer project.
The project was canceled by the project creator on June 3, 2014.
The funding goal for the project was $17,653.
The funding period for the project was from May 17, 2014, to June 16, 2014.
Management Plus categorizes transactions by type based on the general ledger and automatically assigns each transaction to the correct category.
Management Plus calculates and extracts GST and PST taxes from transactions.
Company accountants and accounting firms spend millions on assistants to make tax calculations manually.
Human errors are common in manual tax calculations performed by accountants.
Management Plus calculates and extracts GST and PST taxes from transactions.
Management Plus allows accountants to know exactly how much money to claim back from the government.
Company accountants and accounting firms spend millions paying assistants to make tax calculations manually.
Human errors are always possible in manual tax calculations.
Management Plus resolves the issue of manual tax calculations and provides accountants with necessary information in seconds.
Over 500 companies have agreed to sign up for Management Plus once it is launched.
Some clients of Management Plus are Fortune 1000 companies.
Every accountant that has tested Management Plus in beta mode has found it beneficial.
Management Plus saves accountants considerable time and money.
Accounting firms can turn a profit by billing clients for manual processing while using Management Plus to do the job quickly.
The rewards offered by Management Plus provide visibility towards high-end corporate clients with significant buying power.
Clients of Management Plus include IBM, Canon, and Fujitsu.
The project is called Fully Automated Credit Card Statement Analyzer.
The project was initiated by Alexandre Ouaknine.
The analyzer supports all credit card types, including Visa, MasterCard, and Amex.
Users can add an unlimited number of companies and multiple sets of credit cards.
The analyzer can generate past and present transaction reports that can be printed and archived.
The corporation and servers are located in Montreal, Quebec, Canada.
The project emphasizes safety and confidentiality, using the latest technology to ensure maximum safety.
Users can delete their data at any time.
Management Plus is described as smart and intuitive, learning user needs to improve performance.
Users must log in to their bank account online and download their credit card statement in.CSV format.
Users upload the.CSV file to their Private and Confidential Management Plus account.
Users can print, save, and archive their reports, and consult previous statements later.
The project is titled 'Fully Automated Credit Card Statement Analyzer'.
